sqlMap.select: SELECT decode(b.status,'D','D','C') as STATUS, nvl(b.buyer ,' ') AS BUYER, nvl(b.po_no ,' ') AS PO_NO, nvl(b.po_seq ,' ') AS PO_SEQ, substrb(nvl(replace(replace(replace(replace(decode(b.process_type,'2',f.com_name_loc||'.','')||decode(trim(a.po_remark||' '||b.po_remark),null,null,trim(a.po_remark||' '||b.po_remark)),chr(13),null),chr(10),null),']',')'),'[','('),' '),1,100) as REMARK, nvl(b.buyer_item_no ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, nvl(f_split(b.seller_item_no,'^||^',1) ,' ') AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, nvl(f_split(b.seller_item_no,'^||^',2) ,' ') AS MSM_BRAND_CD, nvl(replace(replace(b.description, chr(13),null),chr(10),null),' ') AS DESCRIPTION, nvl(replace(replace(b.specification, chr(13),null),chr(10),null),' ') AS SPECIFICATION, nvl(b.maker_name ,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, nvl(b.maker_code ,' ') AS MAKER_CODE, nvl(b.add_date ,' ') AS ADD_DATE, nvl(b.add_time ,' ') AS ADD_TIME, nvl(b.change_date ,' ') AS CHANGE_DATE, nvl(b.change_time ,' ') AS CHANGE_TIME, nvl(decode(b.process_type,'2',f_get_tr_date(b.rd_date,-2),f_get_tr_date(b.rd_date,-1)),' ') AS RD_DATE, nvl(b.item_qty , 0 ) AS ITEM_QTY, nvl(b.unit_measure ,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, nvl(b.unit_price , 0 ) AS UNIT_PRICE, nvl(b.item_amt , 0 ) AS ITEM_AMT, nvl(b.agent_price/nvl(value1,1) , 0 ) AS AGENT_PRICE, nvl(b.agent_item_amt/nvl(value1,1), 0 ) AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT, nvl(a.add_user_id ,' ') AS PUR_ID, nvl(c.req_user_id ,' ') AS REQ_ID, CASE WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRKOLO0118' THEN ' ' ELSE nvl(trim(c.req_user_info),' ') END AS REQ_USER_INFO, nvl(b.dely_to_location ,' ') AS PODT_DELY_TO_LOCATION, nvl(replace(replace(replace(replace(a.dely_to_location, chr(13),null),chr(10),null),']',')'),'[','('),' ') as POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION, nvl(b.process_type ,' ') AS PROCESS_TYPE, nvl(b.warehouse_code ,' ') AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, nvl(to_char(b.po_seq,'FM000') ,' ') AS PO_SEQ, CASE WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRKOLO0118' THEN nvl(F_SPLIT(trim(c.req_user_info),'/',1), nvl(d.change_user_name,' ')) WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0140' AND F_SPLIT(c.IV_COLUMN,'^','11') != 'E100' THEN '김민영' WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0123' AND nvl(b.dely_to_location ,' ') = 'Z8095' THEN '한민지' WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0123' AND nvl(b.dely_to_location ,' ') != 'Z8095' THEN '고은해' WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0140' THEN nvl(F_SPLIT(trim(c.req_user_info),'/',1), nvl(d.change_user_name,' ')) ELSE nvl(substrb(d.change_user_name,1,20),' ') END as REQ_NAME, substrb(CASE WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRKOLO0118' THEN nvl(F_SPLIT(trim(c.req_user_info),'/',3), nvl(d.change_user_tel,' ')) WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0140' AND F_SPLIT(c.IV_COLUMN,'^','11') != 'E100' THEN '031-895-8032' WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0123' AND nvl(b.dely_to_location ,' ') = 'Z8095' THEN '02-3016-7297' WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0123' AND nvl(b.dely_to_location ,' ') != 'Z8095' THEN '02-3016-7246' WHEN B.BUYER = 'KRSAMS0140' THEN nvl(F_SPLIT(F_SPLIT(trim(c.req_user_info),'/',2),',',1), nvl(d.change_user_tel,' ')) ELSE nvl(d.change_user_tel,' ') END,1,20) as REQ_TEL, nvl(b.legacy_po_no,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, nvl(b.legacy_po_seq,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, nvl(decode(a.doc_type,'X',b.pr_no,decode(b.byit_comorg_code,'KRILSHG001',b.ref_if_no,replace(b.ref_pr_no,chr(9),null))),' ') AS REF_PR_NO, nvl(replace(replace(c.iv_column,']',')'),'[','('),' ') as IV_COLUMN , nvl(a.po_create_date,' ') AS PO_DATE FROM icompohd a, icompodt b, icomprdt c, icomprhd d, icomcmpy f, icomcod1 cod1 WHERE b.buyer = #TARGET# AND b.po_no = #KEY_1# AND b.status != 'D' AND b.buyer = a.buyer AND b.po_no = a.po_no AND b.buyer = c.buyer AND b.pr_no = c.pr_no AND b.pr_seq = c.pr_seq AND c.buyer = d.buyer AND c.pr_no = d.pr_no AND b.buyer = f.com_code(+) AND cod1.type(+) = 'Z015' AND b.buyer = cod1.code(+)

SELECT replace(replace(nvl(text1,' '),'[','('),']',')') AS REQ_DEPT, nvl(mobile_phone,' ') AS REQ_MOB FROM icomlusr, icomcod2 WHERE user_id = #REQ_ID# AND com_code = company_code(+) AND 'C001' = type(+) AND department = code(+)

SELECT TO_CHAR(count(*)) AS V_CNT, CASE WHEN IS_NUMBER(REPLACE(F_SPLIT(#POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION#,' ',1),'-','')) = 0 THEN F_SPLIT(#POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION#,' ',1) ELSE ' ' END AS ADD_ZIP, CASE WHEN IS_NUMBER(REPLACE(F_SPLIT(#POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION#,' ',1),'-','')) = 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(#POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION#,LENGTH(F_SPLIT(#POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION#,' ',1))+1,300)) ELSE SUBSTR(#POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION#,1,300) END AS ADD_NAME
FROM dual

SELECT nvl(code1,' ') AS COM_IRS_NO, nvl(text1,' ') AS COM_NAME, nvl(text2,' ') AS COM_CEO, nvl(text5,' ') AS COM_ZIP, nvl(text6,' ') AS COM_ADD, nvl(text3,' ') AS COM_INDUSTRY, nvl(text4,' ') AS COM_BUSINESS FROM icomcod4 WHERE buyer = decode(#PROCESS_TYPE#,'2',decode(buyer,'KRSAMS0123', #BUYER#, #WAREHOUSE_CODE#),#BUYER#) AND code2 = #PUR_ID#

SELECT nvl(irs_no,' ') AS COM_IRS_NO, nvl(com_name_loc,' ') AS COM_NAME, nvl(ceo_name_loc,' ') AS COM_CEO, nvl(zip_code,' ') AS COM_ZIP, nvl(substrb(address_loc,1,120),' ') AS COM_ADD, nvl(industry_type,' ') AS COM_INDUSTRY, nvl(business_items,' ') AS COM_BUSINESS FROM icomcmpy WHERE com_code = decode(#PROCESS_TYPE#,'2',decode(com_code,'KRSAMS0123', #BUYER#, #WAREHOUSE_CODE#),#BUYER#) AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT TRIM(REPLACE(COM_NAME_LOC,'코리아이플랫폼(주)','')) AS REQ_NAME , TEL_NO AS REQ_TEL FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #WAREHOUSE_CODE#

select c.text1 AS KEP_PM_DEPT_NM , substrb(b.user_name_loc,1,20) AS KEP_PM_NAME , b.phone_number AS KEP_PM_TEL , b.email AS KEP_PM_EMAIL from mis_buyer_mng a, icomlusr b, icomcod2 c where a.year = to_char(sysdate,'YYYY') and a.status = 'C' and a.priority = 'Y' and a.buyer = #BUYER# and a.kep_user_id = b.user_id and b.com_code = c.company_code and c.type = 'C001' and c.code = a.kep_dept and rownum=1
sqlMap.update: UPDATE icompohd SET send_date = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), send_time = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS') WHERE buyer = #TARGET# AND po_no = #KEY_1#
UPDATE icompodt SET send_date = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), send_time = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS') WHERE buyer = #BUYER# AND po_no = #PO_NO# AND po_seq = #PO_SEQ#

sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KEP.icomcod1 WHERE TYPE = 'MSMI-B' AND CODE = #BUYER#

SELECT POSITION_GROUP AS POSITION_GROUP, MAX(KEP_NAME) AS KEP_NAME, COM_CODE AS COM_CODE, COM_NAME AS COM_NAME, IRS_NO AS IRS_NO FROM ( SELECT COM_CODE AS COM_CODE, COM_NAME_LOC||'/'||COM_NAME_ENG AS COM_NAME, MS.POSITION_GROUP, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=MS.KEP_USER_ID AND STATUS IN ('C','R') ) AS KEP_NAME, IRS_NO AS IRS_NO FROM ICOMCMPY CM, MIS_BUYER_MNG MS WHERE CM.COM_CODE = #BUYER# AND CM.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND MS.STATUS(+) IN ('C') AND CM.COM_CODE = MS.BUYER(+) AND MS.YEAR= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') ) GROUP BY POSITION_GROUP,COM_CODE,COM_NAME,IRS_NO
